# Dataset Information

## Healthcare Provider Fraud Detection Dataset

### Data Source
Download the dataset from: https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/rohitrox/healthcare-provider-fraud-detection-analysis

### Required Files
Place the following files in this directory:
- `Train_Beneficiarydata.csv` - 138,556 patient demographics and chronic conditions
- `Train_Inpatientdata.csv` - 40,474 hospital admission claims
- `Train_Outpatientdata.csv` - 517,737 outpatient claims  
- `Train_labels.csv` - 5,410 provider-level fraud labels

### Generated Files
- `provider_features.csv` - Processed provider-level features (generated by analysis scripts)

### Note
CSV files are excluded from git tracking due to size. Please download from the Kaggle link above.
